package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type CoursePlanNotificationRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

var _ repository.CoursePlanNotificationStore = CoursePlanNotificationRepository{}

func (repository CoursePlanNotificationRepository) Accept(
	ctx context.Context,
	notification domain.CoursePlanNotification,
) (domain.CoursePlanNotification, bool, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeCoursePlanNotification(notification)
	if err != nil || normalized.Outcome.Source != domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher || normalized.DeliveredAt != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	// The current inbox schema predates Planner v2's optional path field. Do
	// not silently discard it if a future caller bypasses the notification
	// handler; a schema migration is required before durable path binding.
	if normalized.Outcome.LearningPathID != "" {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, errors.New("course plan notification repository pool is required")
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox (
    event_id,event_type,request_id,causation_id,student_id,personal_teacher_id,dialog_id,
    source_message_id,teacher_decision_id,status,result_code,course_id,reused,failure_code,
    source,reason,body,occurred_at,accepted_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,NULLIF($7,'')::uuid,NULLIF($8,'')::uuid,NULLIF($9,'')::uuid,$10,$11,
          NULLIF($12,'')::uuid,$13,$14,$15,$16,$17,$18,$19)
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING`,
		normalized.Outcome.EventID, normalized.Outcome.EventType, normalized.Outcome.RequestID,
		normalized.Outcome.CausationID, normalized.Outcome.StudentID, normalized.PersonalTeacherID,
		normalized.Outcome.AuditRefs.DialogID, normalized.Outcome.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID,
		normalized.Outcome.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID, normalized.Outcome.Status,
		normalized.Outcome.ResultCode, normalized.Outcome.CourseID, normalized.Outcome.Reused,
		normalized.Outcome.FailureCode, normalized.Outcome.Source, normalized.Outcome.Reason,
		normalized.Body, normalized.Outcome.OccurredAt, normalized.AcceptedAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := repository.get(ctx, normalized.Outcome.EventID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, err
	}
	if !sameCoursePlanNotification(stored, normalized) {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, false, errors.New("conflicting course plan outcome replay")
	}
	return stored, command.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
}

func (repository CoursePlanNotificationRepository) MarkDelivered(
	ctx context.Context,
	eventID string,
	messageID string,
	deliveredAt time.Time,
) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return errors.New("course plan notification repository pool is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(eventID); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(messageID); err != nil || deliveredAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox
SET dialog_message_id=$2, delivered_at=$3
WHERE event_id=$1 AND (delivered_at IS NULL OR dialog_message_id=$2)`, eventID, messageID, deliveredAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("course plan notification delivery state conflict")
	}
	return nil
}

func (repository CoursePlanNotificationRepository) get(ctx context.Context, eventID string) (domain.CoursePlanNotification, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, errors.New("course plan notification repository pool is required")
	}
	return scanCoursePlanNotification(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT event_id::text,event_type,request_id::text,causation_id::text,student_id,
       personal_teacher_id::text,COALESCE(dialog_id::text,''),COALESCE(source_message_id::text,''),
       COALESCE(teacher_decision_id::text,''),status,result_code,COALESCE(course_id::text,''),
       reused,failure_code,source,reason,body,occurred_at,accepted_at,
       COALESCE(dialog_message_id::text,''),delivered_at
FROM teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox WHERE event_id=$1`, eventID))
}

type coursePlanNotificationRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanCoursePlanNotification(row coursePlanNotificationRow) (domain.CoursePlanNotification, error) {
	var notification domain.CoursePlanNotification
	var deliveredAt *time.Time
	err := row.Scan(
		&notification.Outcome.EventID, &notification.Outcome.EventType, &notification.Outcome.RequestID,
		&notification.Outcome.CausationID, &notification.Outcome.StudentID, &notification.PersonalTeacherID,
		&notification.Outcome.AuditRefs.DialogID, &notification.Outcome.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID,
		&notification.Outcome.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID, &notification.Outcome.Status,
		&notification.Outcome.ResultCode, &notification.Outcome.CourseID, &notification.Outcome.Reused,
		&notification.Outcome.FailureCode, &notification.Outcome.Source, &notification.Outcome.Reason,
		&notification.Body, &notification.Outcome.OccurredAt, &notification.AcceptedAt,
		&notification.DialogMessageID, &deliveredAt,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, err
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanNotification{}, err
	}
	notification.DeliveredAt = deliveredAt
	return domain.NormalizeCoursePlanNotification(notification)
}

func sameCoursePlanNotification(left, right domain.CoursePlanNotification) bool {
	return left.Outcome.EventID == right.Outcome.EventID && left.Outcome.EventType == right.Outcome.EventType &&
		left.Outcome.RequestID == right.Outcome.RequestID && left.Outcome.CausationID == right.Outcome.CausationID &&
		left.Outcome.StudentID == right.Outcome.StudentID && left.Outcome.Status == right.Outcome.Status &&
		left.Outcome.ResultCode == right.Outcome.ResultCode && left.Outcome.CourseID == right.Outcome.CourseID &&
		left.Outcome.Reused == right.Outcome.Reused && left.Outcome.FailureCode == right.Outcome.FailureCode &&
		left.Outcome.Source == right.Outcome.Source && left.Outcome.Reason == right.Outcome.Reason &&
		left.Outcome.AuditRefs == right.Outcome.AuditRefs && left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID &&
		left.Outcome.OccurredAt.Equal(right.Outcome.OccurredAt)
}
